instance.selection: Use target/environment mapping in owner SKILL; never enumerate unrelated profiles or silently fall back.
instance.currentVersion: unknown; historical values are not runtime evidence
instance.addressEvidence: Owner SKILL.md environment tables are the address SSOT; credential variables and exceptions in auth.nativeCredentialPath are selected-instance constraints.

auth.nativeCredentialPath: GROWTHBOOK_API_KEY Secret API Key, Bearer; UI us-ab-management.addx.live, API us-ab-management-api.addx.live.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: User opens target UI Settings API Keys, requests secret API key with minimum role/project. UI IdP is unknown; SDK client keys are not secret REST API keys.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: GET /api/v1/features?limit=1 within authorized project plus key role/project from settings; no dedicated subject probe established, do not call a feature list identity proof.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: Authorized user creates/deletes key in Settings API Keys; verify role and project restrictions from deployed edition. UI session never substitutes for Secret API Key.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.
